ai_summary: AAVAS Financiers Limited successfully passed all three postal ballot resolutions, including the appointment of Mr. Manu Yeshpal Singh as Director and Managing Director, and Mr. Sanjeev Srinivasan as Non-Executive Nominee Director, indicating a significant shift in company leadership. While all resolutions passed, a notable red flag is the 15.37% dissent from Public Institutions regarding Mr. Singh's appointment as Managing Director, which merits further scrutiny into the reasons for this opposition. This leadership restructure will materially impact the company's governance and future strategic direction.
